 Orange Beach Deep Sea Fishing Charters for the Alabama Gulf Coast
 
 Intimidator Fishing Tackle StoreShop Now!!

 Serving Orange Beach, Gulf Shores, Fort Morgan and Perdido Key with offshore trips that focus on real fishing - clear plans, a safety-first crew, and the best targets for the season.
	Choose your trip length below and we'll run the smartest game plan for the day - reef fish on day trips and big-game pelagics on overnights.
  
  
	Pick Your Trip Length
 (We'll Run the Best Plan for the Season)
	Half Day Trip(Bottom Fishing)
 Best for action-packed offshore fishing for reef species like Triggerfish, Vermilion Snapper and other reef fish - with Red Snapper and available seasonally.
	Book a Half Day Trip
	
 
	Full Day(More Range + More Time)
	Full day trips give you more range, more time on productive structures and better odds at quality fish when conditions are right.
	Book a Full Day
	
 
	Overnight / Multi-Day(Big Game) 4-8 people
	Overnight and multi-day trips are built for big water and big opportunity - targeting bottom fish and Yellowfin Tuna, Blue Marlin, Wahoo, Mahi Mahi (Dorado/Dolphin) and other pelagic species.
	Overnight trips are usually one night offshore and multi-day or 3 day trip is 2 nights offshore.
	Request an Overnight Trip
	
 
	Not sure what to book? Text your date + group size + "Day/Full/Overnight" + what you want to catch to (251) 747-2872 and we'll recommend the best option.
  
  
  
	Book Online or Call/Text the Crew
	Check Dates & Book Online
	Fast checkout. Real availability. Book direct.
	 
	Call / Text (251) 747-2872
	Quick answers from the crew - no call center, no middleman, no broker.
	Read Reviews
	 
	Book Online
	Call/Text
	Book in about 30 seconds or text us and we'll steer you right.
  
 See 2026 Pricing & What's Included
  

	What We Catch on Alabama Gulf Coast Deep Sea Fishing Trips
	Day Trips & Full Day Trips(Reef Species)
 Common targets include:
 
 Triggerfish
 Vermilion Snapper
 Great Amberjack
 Other reef fish species
 Red Snapper (seasonal)
 Grouper (seasonal)
 
	
	We tailor the plan to what's open, what's biting and what gives your group the best chance that day.
	Overnight / Multi-Day Trips(Big Game Pelagics)
	Common targets include Yellowfin Tuna, Blue Marlin, Wahoo and Mahi Mahi (Dorado/Dolphin), plus other pelagic species based on season and conditions.
  
  
	What's Included(So You Know Exactly What You're Booking)
	Every trip includes:
 
 Captain + experienced crew (helpful and organized)
 Rods, reels, tackle & bait matched to the trip plan
 Ice + fish storage
 Safety gear + modern offshore electronics
 A clear game plan before departure (targets + approach)
 
	
	After booking, we'll text you the simple "show up ready" checklist so your morning is easy.
  
  
	Why Anglers Book With Us
	Reviews That Match the Experience
	Anglers book with us for straight answers, an efficient crew and a trip that's built around fishing - not confusion at the dock.
	Safety-First Offshore Operation
	We run a professional, safety-first offshore operation. If conditions aren't right, we communicate early and make the smart call.
	Built for Real Fishing(Multi-Passenger)
	This is a multi-passenger deep sea fishing charter for people who want a real shot at reef fish and big game - not a "ride around and hope" trip.
	Overnight trips are limited to 8-10 passengers due to US Coast Guard bunk/berth requirements.
  
  
	Quick Answers Before You Book
	Do you serve Gulf Shores, Fort Morgan and Perdido Key?
	Yes. We serve the Alabama Gulf Coast including Orange Beach, Gulf Shores, Fort Morgan and Perdido Key. After booking, we'll send simple directions and arrival details.
	What fish can we catch on a day trip or full-day trip?
	Most day and full-day trips target reef species like Triggerfish, Vermilion Snapper, Amberjack and other reef fish, with Red Snapper and Grouper available seasonally. We match the plan to current regulations and conditions.
	What's the best trip if we want tuna or marlin?
	Choose an overnight or multi-day trip for pelagics like Yellowfin Tuna, Blue Marlin, Wahoo and Mahi Mahi (Dorado/Dolphin). Big game is a time-and-range game - overnights give you both.
  
  
	Photos, Recent Catches & Social Proof
	Recent Trip Photos
	Real trips. Real Fish. Real Alabama Gulf Coast offshore days.
	Follow Along
	See recent catches and guest photos on social media and tag your trip shots after you land your fish.
  
   
	
	Book your Deep Sea Fishing Trip on the Intimidator Today!!!

 The "Intimidator" is a 65 x 19 ft Sportfisherman 
 Accommodations    Equipment List
 
 ★ Book Now ★ 
 
	
	
 
	Welcome aboard!
 With a deep-vee hull that makes for a comfortable ride in just about any sea condition, this charter boat was hand built for extended offshore fishing charters.  She is smooth, dry and stable with all the amenities you are looking for in a fishing boat.  It is clean inside and out with solid fiberglass throughout for easy cleanup and a beautiful appearance.
 The Coast Guard has been there at every step of the way from laying the keel to the completed construction.  With yearly inspections of both the topside safety equipment and the hull side, we put a lot of effort into safety as you just can't put a price on "piece of mind".
 All crew members are C.P.R. and first aid certified and completely comply with the USCG's zero tolerance random drug testing program.  We are clean cut, mild-mannered and ready to fishing!

 
 
 Accommodations

 
 
 
 We provide all you need to have a good time Fishing aboard the Intimidator Charter Boat!
 
 
 (3) 24,000 Btu Air conditioners and heater units
 plenty of seating inside and outside
 1000 pound per day Scotsman ice maker
 large 350 qt YETI cooler provided for your drinks
 Sleeps 10 passengers plus crew
 All bunks are wide and comfortable no shorter than 84"
 
 Bunks are complete with solid oak bed-rails
 Comfortable seating inside for 12
 Large bathrooms with showers
 1200 Sq. ft. dehumidifier
 KVH Trac-vision 4 satellite TV, Stereo, DVD, CD
 Refrigerator, Microwave, Toaster oven
 Big Green Egg Grill (charcoal and utensils provided)
 Two large interior tables with cup holders
 Plenty of counter space in the galley
 5 Cu. Ft. bait freezer
 24 cup coffee pot (cups, sugar, and creamer provided)
 Cockpit measurement is 20’ x 20’
 
 
  
 
 
 
 
	EQUIPMENT LIST
 
 
 
 
 
 Twin 600 hp 3406 Caterpillar Diesels
 Zf365A transmissions
 Twin 21kw Northern Lights diesel generators
 1200 gallon fuel capacity
 650 gallon water capacity
 USCG inspected for 46 passengers
 All premium Aero-quip fuel and hydraulic lines
 New Hynautic power steering
 Hynautic hydraulic shifters
 Generous fish boxes
 
 
 41 ft Rupp outriggers
 Pompanette 130 class fighting chair
 Scotsman 1000 pound per day ice maker
 350 Gallon circular shaped Live well
 Custom Tuna Tower
 Danforth Compass
 Private Outside bathroom
 
 
 Raymarine ES-120 GPS unit
 Raymarine SR-150 Sirius weather
 Furuno Nav Net/ TZT System
 Furuno 72 nm Radar
 Furuno drs4d-nxt 36 mile doppler radar
 Furuno FCV-1150
 
 
 
 3 Icom 604 Vhf's
 Icom 710 SSB
 Simrad Ap2500 Auto-pilot
 Standard Hailer - intercom system
 ACR Epirb
 Global-star Satellite phone
 Custom Helm chair from Llebroc Industries
 Dytek surface sea temperature

 Orange Beach Marina Driving Directions
	Traveling to the Intimidator Charter Boat from points
 North, East or West for Gulf Shores Deep Sea Fishing
 Click Here For Google Map Directions
	★ Book Now ★
	Trip Pricing (quick view)
 The Intimidator Deep Sea Sportfishing Charter Boat and the Charter Boat Distraction are located at the Orange Beach Marina.  Though we boast Gulf Shores fishing, our address is 27075 Marina Road, Orange Beach, AL. 36561. In Orange Beach, Alabama, we are located off of Alabama Highway 161 (the road between Canal Road and the Beach Road). At the red light, turn east on Marina Road. Go east, 1.1 miles to the Orange Beach Marina, which is located on the left side of the road. Turn left into the Orange Beach Marina. Turn right into the large parking lot that is located in the middle of the property.  (Please do not park in restaurant parking or 1 hour parking or captains parking beside the boats) Walk down the painted brick road to the west. Fishers Restaurant will be immediately on the right. Continue walking toward the Flag Pole and to the left side of the dock store. Our charter boats are on the left dock. Second and third slip on the left, facing west.
 
 Overhead map of area with Slip markings
 
 Boat Slip:  E13
 (click to enlarge)
 
 Photos of Marina Road and Orange Beach Marina
	
 Above is the sign at the red light on Hwy 161. Go east at this sign 1.1 miles.
 
 Above - turn left at this sign into the Orange Beach Marina.
 
 After you turn into the Orange Beach Marina, turn right and park in the largest parking lot. Please do not park in "marked" restaurant parking.
 
 This is what you will see (above) when you leave the parking lot and start walking to the west toward the dock store and charter boats.
 
 Walk past the Restaurants and you will come to the Orange Beach Marina Dock Store. Walk to the left of the store to find us.
 
 When you are on the left side of the Orange Beach Marina Dock Store, the boats will be on the left, down this dock, facing west.
 
 This is the fish cleaning station that is located just before the dock store on the left side of the walkway.
